ui.beammp.accounts.banner: [highlight]Accounts are LIVE! 🎉[/highlight] Recover your old account before logging in old passwords no longer work. Click Read More for recovery instructions.
ui.beammp.accounts.additionalInfoBody: [h4]Recovering your account[/h4][br]All accounts must go through Account Recovery before you can log in. All passwords have been reset, so your old password will not work.[br][br]1. Go to [accountsPortal]accounts.beammp.com[/accountsPortal] and select Start Recovery.[br]2. Enter the email address associated with your BeamMP account, then select Recover Account.[br]3. If you don't receive an email, check your spam folder. If no email arrives, try another email address you may have used or create a new account.[br][br]Early Access Supporters who have already recovered their accounts do not need to repeat this process.[br][h4]After recovery[/h4]You can log in and play, or update your BeamMP Account Profile and link services such as Discord and Patreon.[br][h4]What about Keymaster?[/h4]After recovering your account, use the Keymaster link at the top of the accounts portal. Link your Discord account there to migrate your keys to your BeamMP Account.[br][h4]Need help?[/h4]Open an Account Support ticket in # ❔ Support in our [discordServer]Discord server[/discordServer].
